articles.summary: EPS of $1.29 and Core EPS of $1.40 Reflects Franchise Earning Power Equity Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE: EQBK) (“Equity”, “the Company,” “we,” “us,” “our”), the Wichita-based holding company of Equity Bank, reported net income of $26.8 million or $1.29 per diluted share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Core earnings per diluted share for the quarter was $1.40. “This quarter our company continued to execute at an exciting level. Earnings were strong, production reached all-time highs and loans grew organically. We are putting teams in place with an aligned mission to deepen and expand customer relationships while providing exceptional service to the communities we serve. The results for the quarter reflect that mission,” said Brad S.
